WorkflowUtilitiesPickImageByIndexInput.description:
Input model for selecting a single image from an array by 1-based index.

Pass-through utility: the URL is returned as provided in the input,
without fetching or re-uploading the image.

fallback_index.description: Behavior when `index` exceeds the length of `image_urls`. When `first-image`, returns the first image in the array. When `last-image`, returns the last image in the array. This input has no effect when `index` is within range, when `index` is below 1, or when `image_urls` is empty (the latter two cases still return validation errors). Default is `first-image`.
fallback_index.title: Fallback Index

image_urls.description: Array of image URLs to select from
image_urls.title: Image Urls

index.description: 1-based position of the image to return. Value 1 returns the first image, 2 returns the second, and so on.
index.title: Index

x-fal-metadata.about:
Select a single image from an `image_urls` array by 1-based index.

Returns the URL at the requested position without fetching or
re-uploading the image. The output exposes both an `image` object
and a single-element `images` array so downstream nodes can
reference `image.url` or `images.0.url` interchangeably.

When `index` exceeds the length of `image_urls`, the response falls
back to the image specified by `fallback_index` (default `first-image`)
instead of failing.

Validation: empty `image_urls` -> 422; `index < 1` -> 422.

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).
